scripts.backup:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
TS="$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
DEST="/tmp/aetherguard-enterprise-a5525ead-59d7-4e8e-a02f-74dfe1563768-$TS"
mkdir -p "$DEST"
tar -czf "$DEST/etc-aetherguard.tgz" /etc/aetherguard 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s' "$DEST"
scripts.install:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cat > docker-compose.enterprise.yml <<'EOF'
version: "3.9"
services:
  aetherguard-agent:
    image: ghcr.io/aetherguard/agent:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      AETHERGUARD_SERVER_NAME: localhost
      AETHERGUARD_RATE_LIMIT: "100"
      AETHERGUARD_UPSTREAM: http://backend:3005
    ports:
      - "8081:8080"
EOF
docker compose -f docker-compose.enterprise.yml up -d
scripts.remove:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ -f docker-compose.enterprise.yml ]; then
  docker compose -f docker-compose.enterprise.yml down
fi
scripts.rollback:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
if [ -f docker-compose.enterprise.yml ]; then
  docker compose -f docker-compose.enterprise.yml down
fi
echo "Rollback executed"
scripts.healthcheck:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8081/api/health" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
echo "healthcheck completed"
